title: Berlin Appeals Court Reportedly Had to Check Suspect Citations in Apparently AI-Assisted Family Law Filings
summary: After extensive checking, the Berlin Court of Appeal in Germany reportedly found that a ruling cited in a family law appeal over legal aid did not exist. It could not locate another ruling cited in the original application. The panel described both filings as apparently AI-assisted. It denied the appeal because the applicant had not shown an urgent need for a temporary custody order.
